Phylosophy.Title: My art philosophy
Phylosophy.Description: As Richard Sennet wrote in The Artisan "There is not art without craftwork" For myself, all kind of illustration is an exercise of puting the eye on the detail and getting deeper in each aspect of the picture for the purpouse to obtain an amazing result.

Bio.Title: Hi!
Bio.Description: I'm Sergio. I specialize in Design UI and Graphic Design . Always I love experiment with new forms of artistic expression, such as code. I consider coding as a form to create new pleasant experiences for the user. In my free times you can find me trying to learn guitar and drawing illustrations. I like a good challenge and opportunities to meet diferent connections, so let's connect!

Formation.Title: Formation
Formation.Description: In Fine Arts I learned to code in some signatures, a part of getting skills in volume, composition, color's theory, photography edition (with Adobe Photoshop) and video edition (I profundice myself in wide notions about the use of Adobe Premiere). Furthemore, I specialiced in Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Indesign and textil stamps through extensive courses of universitary formation. After that, I studied a Master of Illustration and Design in València, where I get knowlegdments of design graphic. Actually, I'm doing a Python course in Standofor University

Skills.Title: Skills
Skills.Description: I know many programming languages which I use in my developemts, as Javascript, HTML, CSS3 to web development, or python to automatizations. For other hand, I usually design and illustrate with open source software like Gimp, Kryta and Inkscape.

Hobbies.Title: Hobbys
Hobbies.Description: I love playing guitar and walking on the beach while the sea touch my feets.
